observation.method: Root browser accessibility observation of the authenticated production financial summary, followed by current-page-only workbook export of already loaded data.
observation.scope_note: A prior direct API navigation returned Not authenticated. No forecast API request followed that failed authentication attempt. The supported authenticated UI supplied this separate observation.

code_grounded_inference.accepted_binding: The reviewed UI only replaces summary with forecast after view=forecast, forecast_pending=false and exact session_scope/revision/as_of/started_at equality. The displayed forecast table is evidence of UI contract acceptance, not an independently captured raw tuple.
code_grounded_inference.cost_result: A nonzero known unreceived-products subtotal is consistent with a valid cost preview or a valid snapshot cache result. The complete known-reader-error fallback has no currencies or groups and cannot supply that subtotal.
code_grounded_inference.saved_profit: The product-cost timeout wording is generated from engine.profit_snapshot.quality.source_errors by operational_profit_projection. It is separate from newly requested open_cost_exposure and is not recomputed by opening the report.

limits: This is UI contract acceptance with a private original workbook, not raw API diagnostic acceptance.
No claim of a cold database read, absence of all source error codes, elimination of future timeouts, or measured performance improvement.
Saved actuals, forecast coverage and profit remain incomplete; unavailable values were not treated as zero.
Financial values, entity identifiers and private workbook bytes are retained privately and omitted from this repository evidence.
The export download interval is not report latency and the report generation display is not a database timing measurement.
